{{Top|Leg}}
The '''Twin Fopal 888''' was a type of [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generator]] found in [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. Creating a power loop in the Twin Fopal 888's sequencing system and tuning the generator's rack to form an echo image on a [[power-pulse monitor]] at two to three hundred [[Albar|albars]] can increase the overall maneuverability of the landspeeder.<ref name="Cracken">''[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide]]''</ref>
